text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
――The Qualifiers 2nd Stage has
finally come to an end!
Now, let's see how the overall rankings turned out?!

<chrname> managed to clear the 2nd Stage
with a fairly decent score.

Next is the 3rd Stage, where the competition gets even fiercer.
And once we break through that,
it's finally on to the finals...!

Psyching ourselves up once again with <chrname>,
we set off toward the 3rd Stage!
The day after the 2nd Stage ended—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Site
text_block_list.text:
""Yesterday's "U.A.F." was seriously the best~!
Seeing my fave looking so cool for the first time in a while made me tear up non-stop~~!!""

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Site
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, it's actually really fun to watch.
All the athletes are super serious and passionate.
I honestly underestimated the 'U.A.F.' at first."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Site
text_block_list.text: “I came to see Elfi, but I ended up discovering a whole new favorite... I'm rooting for both of them now!!”

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Site
text_block_list.text:
"Just seeing her healthy and doing her best makes me so truly happy...!
Thank you, 'U.A.F.'!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Ooh...! Ooooooohhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Elfie.
About your stream later today—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san! This is amazing!!
Did you see social media!?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Of course. Even after a day, people are still buzzing with positive feedback.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
“The view count on the event highlight video
is growing way faster than last time...!”

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"The brilliance of you athletes
has finally begun to reach people."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Wah...!
I'm so happyyyy...!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
“—Still, I have no intention
of settling for this.”

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—I will make sure you shine
on an even grander stage, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "And I will make the U.A.F. into a tournament that electrifies everyone and makes them want to watch again and again."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Now that momentum is starting to build,
this is the true critical moment for me.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: —It's a showdown, Ryoka-san!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
What's all this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Let's have a contest to see who can hype up the U.A.F. even more from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it our all together!
Constantly pushing each other to greater heights! And then—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Let's create a tournament that will go down in history!!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...Geez.
We're partners, so making it a contest is just—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's not it.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: —Well then, it's a match, Elfi.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to come up with a stream concept
that'll really blow me away.
I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I'll blow everyone's minds!!
On my pride as an athletic UmaTuber!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm all fired up--!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Elfie looked so genuinely happy—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Pharasing it that way is sure to motivate her more, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Besides, I also...—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Well, time to get to work.

Brimming with palpable excitement,
the U.A.F. begins moving toward the 3rd Stage—!
